ZOHERY TOURS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

Virtual Online Tours

Dear guests, it’s been a tough few weeks for the world as we adjust to a new normal amid the coronavirus pandemic. 

Many of us, on orders of practicing social distancing staying inside, cancel plans, and rework our daily routines. 

During this time, we feel your pain and share your grief because we’re all on the same inside. If you’ve been thinking of an educational recreation, Zohery Tours presents Virtual Online tours of Washington DC. The virtual presentations are conducted by Dr Ali Zohery, Ph.D. The founder and the Owner of Zohery Tours. We will be offering 4 main programs, each of which will showcase a different tour. The duration of the Tours is two hours. You will be regaled with a live narration of the underlying history and significance of the top monuments and main attractions of Washington, DC, the capital city (including the Grand Tour and African American Heritage), Alexandria and Mt. Vernon and Treasures of Egypt.

Each presentation will be illustrated by a slide presentation of the various landmarks of DC. Once you book a tour, you will be sent a link to join the presentation via Zoom videoconferencing application 15 minutes before it starts. You will then be invited to watch the presentation of your choice in the comfort of your home with your loved ones. You will have the opportunity to ask questions during the session.

1) Virtual Online Grand Tour of Washington DC


2) Virtual Online Alexandria and Mt. Vernon Tour


3) Virtual Online Treasures of Egypt Tour


4) Virtual Online African American Heritage Tour of Washington DC

The cost of the each tour is $19 per person.

(when you click, you will be taken to the reservation page where you will be able to choose the tour you’re interested in).
